rule_text: Original artifact must be hashed before template cleanup or transcription.
Owner and verifier cannot be identical roles for closure-sensitive packets.
Every artifact timestamp must include timezone or source clock.
Sensitive original and public surrogate must be linked by packet id.
Packet must identify contradiction/reopen ledger destination.
Alert/message packets must preserve release order and corrections.
Redacted fields require reason code: security/privacy/medical/operational.
Public schedules/meetings/AAR paragraphs cannot mark local closure.
CAP closure requires retest or accepted compensatory proof.
Raw system logs beat screenshots when the two disagree.
A public AAR finding can route work but cannot replace local packet evidence.
Multi-artifact packet requires bundle manifest and item-level hashes.
Artifact captured after decay window must be flagged late and independently verified.
Privileged or sensitive annex cannot be copied into public surrogate.
Any green/ready/passed/closed wording requires adjudication board row.
Unit-level, site-level, county-level and state-level claims must not be merged.
Packet must record source clock: exercise time, system time, or meeting time.
